headline: On October 27, 2019: Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi dies in U.S. raid
captionCards: Al-Baghdadi killed himself and 3 children with a suicide vest.
The raid dealt a major blow to IS leadership.
instagramCaption:
Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi's final moments were explosive. \\[On October 27, 2019, during the U.S. military Barisha raid in northwestern Syria, al-Baghdadi detonated a suicide vest, killing himself and three children. The Islamic State (IS), which he founded, had claimed to be a worldwide caliphate, but this claim was not accepted by most Muslims. This event marked a significant blow to the IS leadership. \\Why do you think this event was so impactful? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
